name: Høgafjellet, Hommersåk (LI)
description:
Østavindsplass.

40min gå tur til toppen.
Hangsted.


Parkering:  https://maps.app.goo.gl/49im43rDkjyfxk4z9
Landing: https://maps.app.goo.gl/BwymKU31fQeCrcKp6  (kun utenom vekst sesong)

Access by walking up gravel road that goes up to mast - there is a locked barrier on this road preventing driving up. Find a take off, above lake elevation ~ 40 minute walk.

Top to bottom depends where you take off from and land - beware of the many power cables in fields below, and the west side of Lifjell is within the terminal controlled airspace (i.e. you need permission from Sola to fly on the other side of the hill).

23.11.2025 fått tillatelse til å lande av grunneier.  på dette jordet. kun utenom vekst sesong .   obs masse liner runt jordet. men langt og fint jorde. Joar.
